newsitem.title: GERMANY: Badenwerk to test eco-friendly diesel.
newsitem.headline: Badenwerk to test eco-friendly diesel.

text.p: German utility Badenwerk AG said on Wednesday it was altering ten of its fleet of trucks to run on environmentally-friendly "bio-diesel" fuel made from rapeseed.
"The aim of this practice test is to see if and how to change the entire diesel fleet over to bio-diesel," Badenwerk said in a statement.

"By changing our fleet over to bio-diesel we can avoid around 1,000 tonnes of carbon dioxide emissions per year and make a tangible contribution to the environment, but we have to see the pros and cons of this in practice," Klaus Kasper, board member of Badenwerk AG, said.
Badenwerk wants to see whether or not the vehicles need a complete refit to work on bio-diesel and whether emissions are significantly lower using bio-diesel compared to fossil fuels.
Bio-diesel can be made in an environmentally-friendly way, while also supporting farmers as rapeseed is traditionally planted on agricultural land during the fallow period.
